annotations.title: Get Instagram profiles, posts and comments

description: Public Instagram data from usernames or post links: profile details with followers, following, bio and links, latest posts and reels with caption, hashtags, mentions, likes, comment count, post time, images, video, carousel items, tagged users, location, audio and a pinned flag, and optionally the comments under each post. No login. Useful for creator research, brand monitoring and social listening. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/instagram-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.0015 per profile or post, $0.0008 per comment; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

comments_per_post.description: Comments to read under each post (0 = none).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

posted_after.description: Only posts on or after this date (2026-11-01) or within a period ("7 days", "2 weeks", "1 month").

posts_per_profile.description: Latest posts to read per profile (0 = profile only).

name: get_instagram_posts

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get Instagram profiles, posts and comments
